synthetic_tapeta.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). Tasmania's ONLY all-weather synthetic track, situated at Spreyton. A 1,500m Tapeta synthetic oval featuring a 350m home straight. The Tapeta surface plays exceptionally uniform regardless of rain, but produces a grinding environment where tactical gate speed ('P') and saving ground along the fence carry a distinct mathematical advantage.
synthetic_tapeta.post_bias: INSIDE BARRIER BIAS: In 1009m, 1150m, and 1350m races, inside barriers (stalls 1–4) hold a strong advantage to command box-seat positioning. Being trapped 3-wide without cover on Tapeta bleeds vital momentum.

handicapping_angles.tapeta_synthetic_surface_specialists: Aggressively upgrade horses with proven synthetic form (Devonport Tapeta or mainland Polytrack/Tapeta). Be skeptical of grass-only runners making their synthetic debut without prior synthetic trial experience (-2.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.spreyton_tactical_speed_advantage: Over 1009m and 1150m sprint dashes, horses with explosive 1st-call gate speed ('E' and 'P') command a nearly 65% win rate. Deep closers ('Swoopers') must make an early move rounding the turn.
handicapping_angles.devonport_cup_carnival: During the January Devonport Cup ($125k Listed) feature meeting over 1880m on Tapeta, race quality elevates to Tasmanian Metro grade. Factor in higher speed par offsets for Cup day feature races.
handicapping_angles.victorian_synthetic_shippers: Mainland Victorian stables (Maher, Wilde, Preusker) shipping runners to Devonport synthetic bring a high underlying speed rating edge (+3.0 pts).
